title: Casper and the Terminal
author: Orsen Quintana
blurb: Cyrus Sterling, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
